search_objective: Identify authoritative sources reporting COVID-19 cases, deaths, hospitalizations, and related epidemiological metrics for New York State and/or New York City during the week of 2024-01-01 to 2024-01-07, covering all target fields: confirmed/probable/suspected/unspecified cases, deaths, hospitalizations, date reported, and source metadata.
search_reasoning: The task requires granular weekly COVID-19 surveillance data for New York in early January 2024. The highest-value sources are: (1) official New York State and NYC public health agency dashboards/reports (NYSDOH, NYC DOHMH), which publish weekly or daily surveillance data; (2) CDC's COVID Data Tracker, which aggregates state-level data and may include hospitalization metrics; (3) structured open-data repositories (e.g., HealthData.gov, CDC open data) that carry machine-readable time-series for this period. News and literature sources are lower priority for this narrow time window but can corroborate official figures. Given the bounds of max 4 queries per iteration and max 10 total queries across 2 iterations, iteration 1 must prioritize the highest-yield official and structured-data channels. The upstream planned queries are broad and do not target the specific New York agency naming conventions (NYSDOH, NYC DOHMH) or CDC tracker terminology. Refined queries should use agency-specific terms and known reporting cadences (weekly surveillance reports, COVID data tracker) to maximize precision. The date range 2024-01-01–2024-01-07 falls in a period when many jurisdictions had shifted to weekly reporting, so queries should include 'weekly' and 'January 2024' as time anchors rather than the hyphenated date string, which is unlikely to appear verbatim in source titles.

query_batch.query_rationale: Directly targets NYSDOH (health.ny.gov) and NYC DOHMH (nyc.gov) official surveillance pages for COVID-19 weekly data in January 2024. These agencies publish weekly COVID-19 reports with confirmed cases, deaths, and hospitalizations broken down by date and geography. Using site: operators maximizes precision for official New York public health sources.

query_batch.expected_trust_signal: Government domain (.ny.gov or nyc.gov), official agency authorship, dated weekly report
